name.ja: 日用品・手に持つもの

DL.rules: An everyday object at real size, generic contemporary design, plausible materials and wear.
DL.negatives: No recognisable product design, no brand shapes or logos, no readable printing, no cigarettes, vapes, alcohol labels or medicine, no money.

TC.rules: A generic electronic device of the stated type and era, realistic proportions, screens shown dark or showing a plain colour.
TC.negatives: No brand logos, no recognisable signature design (no specific phone camera layout, no specific controller shape), no readable screen content, no app icons.

MU.rules: An accurately constructed musical instrument of the stated type with the correct number of strings, keys, holes or frets, real materials.
MU.negatives: No brand headstock shapes or logos, no case, no stand, no sheet music, no extra strings or keys, no plectrum or bow unless stated.

FD.rules: Food or drink served as stated, appetising and realistic, on its own plate, cup or tray, resting on an invisible level surface.
FD.negatives: No table, no cutlery unless stated, no hands, no logos or printed cups, no alcohol bottle labels, no meat on the bone shown raw.

SP.rules: Generic sports or leisure equipment of the stated type at real size, correct technical details.
SP.negatives: No team crests, sponsor logos or brand marks, no weapons or martial-arts weapons, no archery, no firearms of any kind.

FN.rules: A single piece of furniture at real size standing on an invisible level floor, so a posed figure can sit, lean or lie on it; seat height and depth realistic.
FN.negatives: No floor, no rug, no cushions or throws unless stated, no other furniture, no recognisable designer piece.

CN.rules: A historically plausible Chinese object of the stated period, natural materials (bamboo, silk, paper, lacquer, porcelain, bronze), traditional motifs only.
CN.negatives: No readable characters or calligraphy, no seals, no religious objects or incense, no Japanese or Korean features, no plastic, no modern hardware.

name.ja: ファンタジー・アンティーク

FT.rules: An antique or fantasy object that is physically plausible as a crafted thing: brass, glass, leather, wood, parchment.
FT.negatives: Original design, not any franchise item; no weapons, no wands or staffs, no glowing magic effects, no skulls or bones, no occult or religious symbols, no readable writing.
